experiments.name: Decision Sensitivity
experiments.purpose: Test whether the pedagogical decision engine responds to different learner states.
experiments.key_result: Different learner states produced different pedagogical actions.
experiments.does_not_demonstrate: That any particular pedagogical action produces better learning.

experiments.name: RAG Retrieval
experiments.purpose: Test whether learner-specific queries retrieve concept-relevant educational knowledge.
experiments.key_result: 11 of 12 top-3 retrieved chunks belonged to the requested concept.
experiments.demonstrates: Functional concept-relevant retrieval for the tested queries.
experiments.does_not_demonstrate: Formal retrieval accuracy, because no human relevance ground-truth labels were used.

experiments.name: LLM Intervention Consistency
experiments.purpose: Test whether generated interventions follow the selected pedagogical action.
experiments.key_result: Action-specific prompt constraints improved alignment between the selected pedagogical action and the generated intervention in the controlled test.
experiments.demonstrates: The LLM can be constrained to follow the selected pedagogical strategy.

experiments.name: Baseline Comparison
experiments.purpose: Compare ACMF state-dependent decisions with a fixed EXPLANATION baseline.
experiments.key_result: Baseline produced 1 unique action; ACMF produced 4 unique actions and differed from baseline in 3 of 4 cases.
experiments.demonstrates: State-dependent adaptive behavior relative to a fixed strategy.

validated: Concept-relevant RAG retrieval in the tested cases
Adaptive action diversity relative to a fixed baseline
not_yet_validated: Generalization to a large learner population
